meta.notes: Synced 2026-09-25 from the Inner Speech design docs (Preliminary / Research Strategy / IRB). Single-participant study. Shared question-task trial anatomy: fixation -> question prompt -> maintenance delay -> answer cue -> paced inner repetition (yes/no/ready) at fixed cadence -> ITI. In Aim 3, delay is a within-session factor: each session opens with a separated-delay calibration block, then compressed-delay question runs. Answers balanced within category, delay regime, run, and session; ground truth is the intended produced word. Respiration belt + pulse oximeter throughout. Participants report trials they could not answer correctly. All durations and counts are placeholders until the protocol is locked.

detection.label: Detection (saturating)
detection.blurb: Stack same-condition responses so the BOLD level never settles; maximises univariate contrast power per minute.

estimation.label: Single-trial estimation
estimation.blurb: Maximises the estimability of individual trial betas, which is what linear multivariate decoding is actually trained on.

separation.label: Full HRF separation
separation.blurb: Returns to baseline between trials and resolves the stimulus response from the response window, giving clean event-aligned clips.

trials.name: Aim 1 — Block localizer
trials.note: Counterbalanced cued-repetition blocks (yes / no / neutral 'ready' / rest) for the Aim 1 localizer. Block order counterbalanced across the session. Outputs functional ROI masks + production-vs-auditory-monitoring stage labels for Aims 2-3.

trials.name: Aim 2 — Question trial
trials.note: Shared question-task anatomy used by Aims 2 and 3 (compressed runs). Question bank: Standard types (General Knowledge, Arithmetic, Rhyme Judgment, Category, Biographical, Emotional) + Control types (No Prompt affirmative/negative, Neutral 'ready', Opposite Answer, No Answer, Ambiguous Category). Within-trial jitter of the prompt-to-cue delay decorrelates question-reading from repetition responses; between-trial ITI jitter decorrelates from the previous trial's hemodynamic tail.

trials.name: Aim 3 — Separated calibration trial
trials.note: No question prompt: cued yes/no at a jittered long wait. Doubles as long-delay reference data; the FIR time courses estimated here set Aim 3's window lengths and initialise the state-space kernel.

trials.name: Rest — unlabeled
trials.note: Optional resting run: unlabeled data for Aim 3 arm 12 self-supervised pretraining.

runs.name: Aim 1 — Block localizer run
runs.note: 8 blocks per run (cued-yes, cued-no, neutral 'ready', rest x2, counterbalanced). Each block is one trial design instance: rest / cued repetition / rest. Placeholder counts.

runs.name: Aim 2 — Question run
runs.note: Question-task runs for Aim 2 single-trial LSS decoding. Answers balanced within category, delay regime, run, and session.

runs.name: Aim 3 — Compressed question run
runs.note: Compressed-delay regime (~4-8 s prompt-to-cue): the bulk of Aim 3 sessions. Feeds the spatiotemporal model ladder; decision-deadline and delay-regime accuracy curves.

runs.name: Aim 3 — Separated calibration run
runs.note: Session opener for Aim 3: ~5-10 fully separated trials at jittered long delay (placeholder: 8). Long-delay reference data + FIR timing estimates. Also usable as separated-delay data for Aims 1-2.

runs.name: Rest run (unlabeled)
runs.note: Optional resting run (placeholder 6 min): unlabeled data for Aim 3 arm 12 self-supervised pretraining.

sessions.name: Aim 1 — Localizer & question session
sessions.note: Localizer + event-related question task. First-level GLM: question-reading boxcar, delay/maintenance boxcar, cue-locked repetition regressors (yes/no/ready/opposite-rule), no-answer and cue-only trials; canonical double-gamma HRF + temporal derivative; FIR model on separated calibration data for timing estimates. Participants report trials they could not answer correctly. Session order: prep → 2 localizer runs → structurals → 1 question run.

blocks.label: MRI safety screening and consent check

sessions.name: Aim 2 — MVPA session
sessions.note: Single-trial LSS response estimates; linear classifiers (L2 logistic regression, linear SVM, ridge, shrinkage LDA) on Aim-1 ROI / anatomical language / whole-brain features, + searchlight. Leave-one-session-out and leave-question-family-out splits; sealed sessions touched once. Nuisance-only, control-region, and question-text-only negative controls on every split. Session order: prep → 1 question run → structurals → 2 question runs.

blocks.label: MRI safety screening and consent check

sessions.name: Aim 3 — Time-series session
sessions.note: Delay is a within-session factor: separated-delay calibration run first, then structurals, then compressed-delay question runs, then optional rest. Feeds the spatiotemporal model ladder (arms 0-14) trained on identical data budgets; accuracy-vs-deadline and accuracy-vs-delay curves; three-way temporal ablation (context length x hemodynamic lag x temporal smoothing) is Aim-3-only.
